title: Convergence Rate of a Functional Learning Method for Conditional Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.13048v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider a stochastic optimization problem involving two random variables: a context variable $X$ and a dependent variable $Y$. The objective is to minimize the expected value of a nonlinear loss functional applied to the conditional expectation $\mathbb{E}[f(X, Y,\beta) \mid X]$, where $f$ is a nonlinear function and $\beta$ represents the decision variables. We focus on the practically important setting in which direct sampling from the conditional distribution of $Y \mid X$ is infeasible, and only a stream of i.i.d. observation pairs $\{(X^k, Y^k)\}_{k=0,1,2,\ldots}$ is available. In our approach, the conditional expectation is approximated within a prespecified parametric function class. We analyze a simultaneous learning-and-optimization algorithm that jointly estimates the conditional expectation and optimizes the outer objective. translated_title: 条件随机优化的函数学习方法及其收敛速率
translated_abstract: 我们考虑一个涉及两个随机变量的随机优化问题：上下文变量 $X$ 和因变量 $Y$。目标是最小化应用于条件期望 $\mathbb{E}[f(X, Y,\beta) \mid X]$ 的非线性损失泛函的期望值，其中 $f$ 是非线性函数，$\beta$ 表示决策变量。我们关注一个具有重要实际意义的场景：在这种情况下，无法直接从 $Y \mid X$ 的条件分布中采样，只有独立同分布的观测对数据流 $\{(X^k, Y^k)\}_{k=0,1,2,\ldots}$ 可用。在我们的方法中，条件期望在一个预先指定的参数函数类中被近似。我们分析了一种同时学习与优化的算法，该算法联合估计条件期望并优化外层目标函数。通过使用一种特殊设计的非最优性度量，并结合……的平方范数（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对无法直接从条件分布采样的条件随机优化问题，提出在参数函数类中近似条件期望并同时学习与优化的算法，并给出了该方法的收敛速率分析。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes a simultaneous learning-and-optimization algorithm for conditional stochastic optimization, which approximates the conditional expectation within a parametric function class when direct sampling is infeasible, and establishes the convergence rate of the method.
